name: guardrails-eval
description: Assimilate Guardrails AI validation into Ouroboros audit and handoff artifacts.

commands.name: validate-output
commands.summary: Validate a known LLM output against a Guardrails spec and emit an Ouroboros report.

arguments.name: spec
arguments.description: Repo-relative Guardrails RAIL or JSON guard spec path.

arguments.name: output
arguments.description: Repo-relative LLM output artifact to validate.

arguments.name: text
arguments.description: Inline text to validate when no output path is provided.

arguments.name: metadata
arguments.description: Repo-relative JSON metadata passed to Guardrails validators.

arguments.name: report
arguments.description: Repo-relative path for normalized report JSON.

arguments.name: handoff
arguments.description: Repo-relative path for downstream Ouroboros handoff JSON.

arguments.name: no_fail_on_validation_fail
arguments.description: Return exit 0 for validation failures after writing evidence.

capabilities.name: ledger
capabilities.reason: Emit validation pass/fail evidence payloads for the ledger.

capabilities.name: provenance
capabilities.reason: Record bounded guard spec, metadata, and target references.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.reason: Attach validation reports for downstream Ouroboros workflows.

capabilities.name: state
capabilities.reason: Persist validation session status and report/handoff paths.

permissions.reason: Read Guardrails specs, metadata, reports, and target artifacts.
Write normalized validation reports and handoff artifacts.
